title: Case statement matching constant identifiers (not literal strings)
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Process samples `op` and dispatches via a case statement whose `when` arms reference named constants (OP_LOAD = x"0B", OP_ADDI = x"07", OP_MOV = x"0C", OP_HALT = x"0F"). out_reg gets a distinct value per matched arm. Without identifier resolution at execution time, every dispatch falls to `when others` and out_reg stays at the others value. Mirrors P2A's CPU FSM dispatch shape.
